entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: A message sent by the network to reject a registration request from the UE.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: The procedure initiated by the UE to register with the network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: The state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: The state where the UE is not registered with the network.

relations.description: The registration procedure includes the reception of a REGISTRATION REJECT message.
Receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message causes the UE to enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
The REGISTRATION REJECT message is sent when the UE is in the EMM-REGISTERED state.
